component.name: TextEditBoxProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.top.backgroundColor = "0x101420FF"
header = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") header.translation = [40, 30] header.text = "TextEditBox Vertical Anchor Probe" header.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" header.font = "font:LargeSystemFont" m.top.appendChild(header)
sub1 = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") sub1.translation = [40, 90] sub1.width = 1840 sub1.wrap = true sub1.text = "Red tick = the box's translation.y. Cyan ticks = every 50px. Where do the glyphs (case A/B) sit relative to the red tick? Take a device screenshot (Developer Settings), then Home/Back to exit. Numeric boundingRect() readings print to telnet a moment after boot." sub1.color = "0xCCCCCCFF" sub1.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.top.appendChild(sub1)
m.caseA = buildRulerCase("A - typed text (Wgy)", 80, 420, true, "Wgy", "") m.caseB = buildRulerCase("B - hint text only", 1000, 420, false, "", "Enter a password") m.caseJ = buildJellyfinAnalog(80, 700) m.caseD = buildDefaultBoxCase(80, 880)
m.settleTimer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.settleTimer.duration = 1.0 m.settleTimer.observeField("fire", "onSettled") m.top.appendChild(m.settleTimer) m.settleTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onSettled() p("bounds", "A-typed-text", "customBg text=Wgy | rect=" + r(m.caseA.boundingRect())) p("bounds", "B-hint-only", "customBg hintText only | rect=" + r(m.caseB.boundingRect())) p("bounds", "J-jellyfin-analog", "customBg text=Erika, translation.y=40 (case-local) | rect=" + r(m.caseJ.boundingRect())) p("bounds", "D-default-bg", "built-in background, hintText only | rect=" + r(m.caseD.boundingRect())) p("bounds", "done", "") end sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Case builders '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Ruler + one TextEditBox with a custom (hidden) background. Labeled major ticks run from ' -100 to +150 every 25px, offset from the box's own translation.y; short unlabeled fine ' ticks every 5px in between let you read an exact pixel value by counting from the ' nearest label. All to the LEFT of the box, which sits at local x = boxX. function buildRulerCase(caseId as string, x as integer, y as integer, useText as boolean, textVal as string, hintVal as string) as object group = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") group.translation = [x, y]
boxX = 190
title = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") title.translation = [0, -170] title.text = caseId title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" title.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" group.appendChild(title)
offset = -100 while offset <= 150 isMajor = (offset mod 25) = 0 tick = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") tick.translation = [0, offset] if isMajor tick.width = boxX - 15 else tick.width = 30 ' fine tick: short, close to the box, no label tick.translation = [boxX - 15 - 30, offset] end if tick.height = 1 if offset = 0 tick.color = "0xFF3B30FF" ' red - translation.y itself else if (offset mod 50) = 0 tick.color = "0x30D0FFFF" ' cyan - major gridline every 50px else if isMajor tick.color = "0x999999FF" ' light gray - labeled 25px tick else tick.color = "0x3A3A3AFF" ' faint gray - unlabeled 5px fine tick end if group.appendChild(tick)
if isMajor lbl = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") lbl.translation = [0, offset - 12] lbl.width = boxX - 20 lbl.height = 24 lbl.horizAlign = "right" lbl.vertAlign = "center" lbl.font = "font:TinySystemFont" s = itos(offset) if offset > 0 then s = "+" + s lbl.text = s if offset = 0 lbl.color = "0xFF3B30FF" else lbl.color = "0xAAAAAAFF" end if group.appendChild(lbl) end if
offset = offset + 5 end while
teb = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TextEditBox") teb.translation = [boxX, 0] teb.backgroundUri = "pkg:/images/transparent.png" teb.width = 420 teb.textColor = "0xFFFFFFFF" teb.hintTextColor = "0xAAAAAAFF" if useText teb.text = textVal teb.cursorPosition = len(textVal) teb.active = true else teb.hintText = hintVal end if group.appendChild(teb)
m.top.appendChild(group) return teb end function
' Reproduces the exact real-app numbers this probe exists to verify: a sibling background ' Poster/Rectangle height=60 at y=8, TextEditBox translated to y=40 (both relative to this ' group) - matching a Jellyfin-style "own background, hidden built-in box" input field. function buildJellyfinAnalog(x as integer, y as integer) as object group = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") group.translation = [x, y]
title = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") title.translation = [0, -40] title.text = "J - Jellyfin analog (background h=60 @ y=8, box translation.y=40) - does the text look centered?" title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" title.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" group.appendChild(title)
bg = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 8] bg.width = 500 bg.height = 60 bg.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" group.appendChild(bg)
teb = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TextEditBox") teb.translation = [20, 40] teb.backgroundUri = "pkg:/images/transparent.png" teb.width = 440 teb.text = "Erika" teb.textColor = "0x101010FF" group.appendChild(teb)
m.top.appendChild(group) return teb end function
' Control case: default/built-in background (no override). Not the open question, but ' cheap to include so the same screenshot also confirms this case is unaffected. function buildDefaultBoxCase(x as integer, y as integer) as object group = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Group") group.translation = [x, y]
title = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") title.translation = [0, -40] title.text = "D - default/built-in background (control - not the open question)" title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" title.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" group.appendChild(title)
teb = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TextEditBox") teb.translation = [0, 0] teb.width = 440 teb.hintText = "Default hint text" group.appendChild(teb)
m.top.appendChild(group) return teb end function
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function r(rect as object) as string if rect = invalid then return "<invalid>" out = "{x=" + n(rect.x) out = out + " y=" + n(rect.y) out = out + " w=" + n(rect.width) out = out + " h=" + n(rect.height) return out + "}" end function
function n(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "?" if v >= 0 then return itos(int(v + 0.5)) return itos(-int(-v + 0.5)) end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(phase as string, caseId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + caseId + "|" + detail end sub
